method: Full selected source HTML/SCSS and both powerup UI modules reread. They use CSS background images, distinct from the three TextureLoader world maps. Native CPU decoder checked against original PNG RGBA and analytic premultiplication-before-interpolation/source-over. No browser, GL context, driver query, window, focus change, audio or OS input.
changes: Four PNGs premultiplied once at decode; two SVGs retain resvg premultiplied bytes. Alpha/layout/source crops/density unchanged.
All six production HUD/splash draw paths use the existing premultiplied shader and ONE/ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA for RGB and alpha. Opacity multiplies both associated RGB and alpha once.

Premultiplied material factory now uses weak Rc cache, with no new shader, custom uniform or blend state. Same pipeline per concurrent owner lifetime; last owner releases GPU handle. Caller field types updated in eight views.
Powerup active slot paints after inactive slot, matching source immediate z-index:2 versus 1 across swap, regardless ongoing transforms.

checks.suite: 114 tests (101 library + 13 binary) pass; check --all-targets passes with two pre-existing unused-import example warnings
checks.analytic: snowball-hud-alpha-audit.json compares bilinear samples at three phases, two source background colors and opacities 1/.35. Native 8-bit rounding max < .5/255 versus exact-float premultiplied target; this is NOT an observed browser error.
checks.release: Application and snowball_capture diagnostic build; neither launched.

limits: No GPU render, browser-native pixels, driver mipmap behavior, trilinear minification/anisotropy, exact CSS filtering or runtime cache allocation/release measurement. Existing Snowball minification policy retained.
No claim of complete HUD phase/layout/stacking-context/input or texture clarity parity; full world/elf-eye AA/compositing remain open.
No shader pipeline behavior changed in other views; they share the same shader without scene-specific uniforms. Automatic model/projection/default texture state remains Macroquad-managed.
